title: fix(ci): Axios preservation gate requires a major-1 declaration, not one patch version
intent: Unblock Dependabot Axios bumps (first hit: PR #490, axios 1.21.0 -> 1.21.1). The preservation tool's live-tree gate required packages/client/package.json to declare exactly "^1.21.0". Updating that pin means editing scripts/investigations/client_axios_preservation.py, a preservation-owned path, while the boundary test forbids any change set that edits the preservation together with packages/client/package.json. So no Axios bump could pass both. The gate now asks what the preservation actually needs: Axios still declared (removal not authorized), as a caret range on major 1.
behavior_change: CI and investigation tooling only. No client, route, dependency or archive byte changes. The archive's recorded declaration at SOURCE_COMMIT ("axios_declared": "^1.21.0" in MANIFEST.json and CAPABILITY_INDEX.md) is historical and unchanged; build_plan still emits it and the byte-equality tests still hold.

diff_articulation.what_changed: client_axios_preservation.py: new axios_declaration_problem(declared) returns why the live declaration blocks preservation (absent, or not a ^1.x.y range) or None; build_plan raises PreservationError with that reason instead of comparing to the literal "^1.21.0". test_client_axios_preservation.py: AxiosDeclarationGate pins both directions (accepts ^1.21.0, ^1.21.1, ^1.22.0; rejects absent, ^2.0.0, *, latest, exact 1.21.1, ~1.21.1, ^1.21, ^10.0.0) and checks the live tree passes.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Without it PR #490 cannot go green: either the gate fails on ^1.21.1, or editing the gate trips the boundary test. The same deadlock would recur on every later Axios bump.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: The boundary rule itself (OWNED_PREFIXES, ALLOWED_PREFIXES, PROTECTED_PATHS). The historical axios_declared value and every archived byte. test_client_axios_reachability.py and test_client_rosette_compare_lineage.py still pin the exact range; #490 updates those, as they are not preservation-owned.

commands_run: PR #490 head 0ae998ec merged with main, pins updated in all five places: test_client_axios_preservation.py::Boundary::test_preservation_change_leaves_production_client_router_and_inventory_alone FAILED (tool edit + package.json in one change set) -> the deadlock reproduced

files.intent: Live-tree gate: Axios declared as a caret range on major 1, not one literal version.
files.behavior_change: Investigation tooling only; build_plan no longer rejects an Axios patch or minor bump.
